tools.name: get_stamp
tools.description: Status of one stamp: pending, complete (with the Bitcoin block height and time, and a statement of what it proves) or failed (not confirmed within 7 days). Free.

tools.name: get_proof
tools.description: The current .ots proof of one stamp, base64. Once get_stamp says complete, fetch it again: the complete proof carries the Bitcoin attestation and can be verified by anyone, without us. Save it next to the file as <file>.ots. Free.

tools.name: verify_proof
tools.description: Check an OpenTimestamps proof (from us or anyone) against the SHA-256 of a file. Returns valid with status complete (Bitcoin block and the time the file existed by), valid with status pending (not in Bitcoin yet), or invalid with a reason.
